hop_glosses: Hop 1 identifies the country via its two capitals; hop 2 supplies its largest and most populous city.

sufficient_sets.text: Pretoria is the administrative capital, while Cape Town, as the seat of Parliament, is the legislative capital, and Bloemfontein is regarded as the judicial capital.
The largest and most populous city is Johannesburg, followed by Cape Town and Durban.

text: The country whose administrative capital is Pretoria and whose legislative capital is Cape Town has which largest and most populous city?
